provenance.notes: Oswald Chambers, My Utmost for His Highest (1927) — public domain in all jurisdictions

documents.author: Oswald Chambers
documents.canonical_citation: My Utmost for His Highest — September 29
documents.text: Faith is deliberate confidence in the character of God whose ways you may not understand at the time.

documents.author: Oswald Chambers
documents.canonical_citation: My Utmost for His Highest — January 5
documents.text: God does not give us overcoming life; He gives us life as we overcome.

documents.author: Oswald Chambers
documents.canonical_citation: My Utmost for His Highest — June 22
documents.text: My worth to God in public is what I am in private.

documents.author: Oswald Chambers
documents.canonical_citation: My Utmost for His Highest — August 2
documents.text: The battle is lost or won in the secret places of the will before God, never first in the external world.

documents.author: Oswald Chambers
documents.canonical_citation: My Utmost for His Highest — October 17 (Prayer)
documents.text: We have to pray with our eyes on God, not on the difficulties.

documents.author: Oswald Chambers
documents.canonical_citation: My Utmost for His Highest — October 31
documents.text: The greatest competitor of devotion to Jesus is service for Him.

documents.author: Oswald Chambers
documents.canonical_citation: My Utmost for His Highest — November 5
documents.text: God cannot give us happiness and peace apart from Himself, because it is not there.

documents.author: Oswald Chambers
documents.canonical_citation: My Utmost for His Highest — August 31
documents.text: Holiness, not happiness, is the chief end of man.

documents.author: Oswald Chambers
documents.canonical_citation: My Utmost for His Highest — February 14
documents.text: The grace of God is the overflowing favour of God; you can always count on it being there to draw upon.

documents.author: Oswald Chambers
documents.canonical_citation: My Utmost for His Highest — March 9
documents.text: If you are going to be used by God, He will take you through a multitude of experiences that are not meant for you at all; they are meant to make you useful in His hands.

documents.author: Oswald Chambers
documents.canonical_citation: My Utmost for His Highest — May 1
documents.text: The love of God is not a sentimental feeling; it is sovereign and almighty, and will have its way.

documents.author: Oswald Chambers
documents.canonical_citation: My Utmost for His Highest — October 17 (Greater Work)
documents.text: Prayer does not fit us for the greater works; prayer is the greater work.
